Recipe for stitched long videos with invisible join + stable colour: (1) dual sampling in context mode = 4 low-res + 4 high-res steps at lowres scale 0.65 (~1.5x upscale) - fewer low-res steps + smaller ratio kills washout and colour shift; (2) 0.1 noise on the reference frames right before the seam, last frame clean - removes flicker; (3) Color Transfer(target_frame) matching the new segment to the previous segment's last frame, applied to the whole new segment, corrected at an intermediate stage. Second stage uses community upscaler h3_upscaler_lms_v0.1 (Alissonerdx/Minimax-H3-ComfyUI, 0.69GB, sharper than stock). 2-step turbo LoRAs 'basically unusable'; keep 4-step v1.2 / 8-step 768. 5090 runs ComfyUI 0.38.0 and has the int8 VAE, so the new fast-VAE lever is live.
